# Ready to Become a Member?

[Become a member](https://join.northwind-cu.example/) [Join online](https://join.northwind-cu.example/)

## You're Eligible to Join If Any of These Sound Like You

- You live or work in Harbor County or Lakeside County.

- You have an immediate family member who's a member.

To join, open a savings account with $25 or more.
